title: Streaming and SSE
done when: You stream tokens from an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to a browser over SSE and handle disconnects and backpressure.

title: Retrieval and RAG
done when: You build hybrid retrieval (BM25 plus vectors with reranking) over a real corpus and measure recall before touching the generator.

title: LLM evaluation
done when: You run an eval suite against two models on your own endpoint and report the delta with confidence intervals.

title: Model routing and cascades
done when: You can design a cascade that sends easy traffic to a small model and show the cost and quality trade-off on a held-out set.
